origin.description: Converts strptime-style format strings to ICU format strings.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character vector of date/time format strings.

arguments.name: ignore_special
arguments.text: FALSE leaves a name such as datetime_full or date_relative_short unchanged.

origin.details: Most %x specifiers become ICU pattern letters. %% becomes %. %x, %X, %u, %w, %g, %G, %c, %U, and %V warn. ignore_special is true only for a length-1 logical TRUE.

translation.description: Turns a strptime pattern into an ICU pattern.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those. None is an empty vector. The string "NA" is text.

arguments.name: ignore_special
arguments.text: True only for a length-1 bool True. A number, False, or NA leaves style names unquoted.

translation.details: Literals are quoted. An apostrophe inside a literal becomes a backslash and a quote. %% becomes %. %n and %t stay outside quotes. The same specifiers warn as in stringi.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list or tuple returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_fstr
x = stri_datetime_fstr("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
print(f'stri_datetime_fstr("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") returns {x}.')
